selected_lane.reason: E62 ruled that local diagnostics and public callback-shape documentation were insufficient to close broker/front close rejection semantics. This slice turns that gap into a guarded evidence contract before any future Paper retry.

changes: build_close_rejection_diagnostic_semantics now requires primary_broker_front_close_rejection_rule_source for typed close rejection blockers.
build_close_rejection_diagnostic_semantics now marks local_diagnostics_sufficient_to_close=false and primary_rule_source_required=true for typed blockers.

build_close_offset_owner_rule_semantics now requires adapter_native_repair_beyond_local_diagnostics plus primary_broker_front_close_rejection_rule_source before future retry evidence can close the owner blocker.

open_blocker.description: A future Paper close retry still requires either a primary broker/front close rejection rule source or an adapter/native repair that proves the submit-boundary close offset semantics beyond local diagnostics, plus a fresh formal retry authorization.
